purchase_objections: The hero review clicks 'Accept all' (f_38); that is the same blind trust the film mocks, so 'you checked' rings hollow.
The deck proof is an added boardroom photo (f_36), an edit I never asked for, which contradicts 'leaves the rest alone'.
The Evidence panel cites a 'New lender deck' and covenant pack (f_47), not my DACH change, so I can't tell if the evidence is for this edit.
'Cloud AI may process document content' (f_50): as a lawyer or deal team I need to know where client data goes before anything else.
Formatting wrecked was pain #1, but I never see my firm's template survive a round-trip back to real PowerPoint/Word.
The chatbot villain regenerates a whole deck three times; I'd just edit slide 4 by hand, and Copilot already edits inside PowerPoint. The comparison feels like a straw man.
would_try: maybe: the cross-file tracked-change list catching slide 4 is the first AI-office pitch that matches how I actually get burned, but I'd only try it on a non-client file until data handling is clear.
buy_decision: TRY_FIRST: it flips to BUY if I see it on a real firm-template deck and model, with each change reviewed individually and the file opening intact in PowerPoint, plus a clear statement of what leaves my machine.
